stations.title: Station IDs
stations.description: Enter up to 10 GHCN-Daily station IDs starting with US, such as USW00023174. Use this field or station search.

stationSearch.title: Station search
stationSearch.description: Search NOAA's station metadata by two-letter U.S. state code (state), bounding box ([north, west, south, east] in bbox), or both. Search uses up to 10 matching stations. Clear Station IDs to use this field.

state.title: State code
state.description: A two-letter uppercase U.S. state code, such as CA.

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: Four coordinate values in north, west, south, east order.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First observation date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last observation date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD. Each daily observations request covers up to 366 days and 10 stations. Longer ranges are split into sequential requests.

dataTypes.title: Observation types
dataTypes.description: GHCN-Daily element codes. Defaults to TMAX, TMIN, PRCP, SNOW, SNWD, and AWND. See the README for additional supported elements.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit system used by NOAA for output values.
